description: The file contains utility functions and parameters for launching Metal compute kernels in an Apple Metal backend for neural network computation, specifically related to MPSCNN (Metal Performance Shaders CNN) within the Torch library. It includes a division utility, parameter calculation functions for kernel launches, and references Objective-C interfaces.

classes.name: LaunchParams
classes.description: Structure holding thread and grid size parameters for kernel launch

methods.name: divRoundUp
methods.description: Returns the result of dividing x by y, rounded up to the next integer

methods.name: spatialPointwiseKernelLaunchParams
methods.description: Calculates launch parameters for kernel execution based on image and pipeline information
